conversationalSummary.text: For TODAY, Almagreira after work (around the 16:30 start) is the only thing that might line up, but it’s a rare window and the forecasts are pretty underwhelming. I’d check the Surfline cams and MEO Beachcam before you leave—if it doesn’t look noticeably better than expected, I’d skip it. Wind is a bit mixed and it’s still an exposed north-coast beach break, so the session can flip from workable to messy fast. If the cams look much cleaner than the forecast suggests, then go.
